description: The plot illustrates the relationship between step number and accuracy for two experiments. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The first line, colored blue and marked with circular data points, represents “Ex1 Accuracy”; it begins at a value of 0.10 at a step of 0, rises to approximately 0.38 at a step of 10000, remains relatively stable at around 0.39 between steps 10000 and 40000, and concludes at 0.39 at a step of 60000. The second line, colored teal and marked with diamond data points, represents “Ex2 Accuracy”; it starts at 0.24 at a step of 0, increases to approximately 0.36 at a step of 10000, declines to 0.32 at a step of 20000, and ends at 0.33 at a step of 60000.
